setup(address[],address).details: Enables modules and sets a transaction guard on a Safe being created.

params.guard: Transaction guard address, or zero address for no guard.
params.modules: Set of modules to enable. Must be non-empty, with no zero addresses and no duplicates.

setup(address[],address).notice: This function must only be called via `DELEGATECALL` from Safe `setup()`.
